claim: The sample demo is isolated and does not change a real session.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the bundled video and six WebVTT cues load, demo banner is visible, and only IndexedDB key demo:current is written.

claim: Switch between all cues and dialogue only, then temporarily reveal hidden environmental cues.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; switch to Dialogue only, hold R to reveal a hidden environmental cue, and complete a dialogue practice line.

claim: The viewer sends no sample or session data to third parties.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; record every request through the sample filtering and practice flow and assert every request remains same-origin.

claim: Local video files are never saved by the app.
where: File picker, session controls, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; select a browser-generated local WebM, inspect the separate demo session record, and assert it contains no local video filename or bytes.

claim: Export and import the editable caption session as JSON.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; export after changing the filter, inspect the JSON, clear the session, and import that exact download.

claim: The complete sample demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; wait for the service worker, reload once online, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample cues and video remain available.
